method: Public search-result and source-page comparison. Rumor entries record observed discussion signals and authoritative-route checks; they are not download confirmations and not proof of maintainer endorsement.

rumors.name: Verity Souls
observedPhrases: Verity mod made by ThatMob and voice actor
whatIsConfirmed: Current public SERP sampling shows Verity Souls wording in Reddit discussion, Instagram reels, Facebook video text, and a YouTube community-post snippet.
Current public discussion connects the phrase with a possible future Verity-related Minecraft project.
The checked CurseForge thatmobyt profile currently lists three visible Verity-related projects: Verity - Bedrock Edition, Verity BE, and Verity JE.
whatIsNotConfirmed: No checked CurseForge, Modrinth, MCPEDL, or official project page was found with the exact Verity Souls title.
No official Project ID, file record, version ID, package type, or checksum was found for a Verity Souls download route.
Social posts and Reddit comments are discussion signals, not a safe download source.

authoritativeChecks.result: Visible profile check showed three projects and did not show a Verity Souls project title at check time.
Current official Java adaptation route remains Verity JE, not Verity Souls.

publicDiscussionSignals.signal: Thread includes recent player comments about a possible future Verity Souls name and many download-confusion comments.
Public search snippet repeats the claim that the mod may be called Verity Souls.
Public search snippet references Verity Souls in a making-a-real-mod context.
Public search snippet says a mod called Verity Souls is coming out.

safeUserAction: Do not download a file only because a video or comment says Verity Souls.
Wait for a maintainer-controlled project page with owner, Project ID, file record, version, package type, and setup notes.
Use Verity JE, Verity BE, PnTMC Bedrock, MCPE, VERITY.exe, or Remastered routes when the source page names those existing projects instead.
